C08-M09-L05-F1.title: Account-compromise signs and visibility
C08-M09-L05-F1.caption: Different activity requires different sources. The lab observes VPN and endpoint signals but omits provider and mailbox audit data.
C08-M09-L05-F1.alt: Table of four kinds of identity signal. Location or concurrency uses IdP, VPN and proxy data and may be caused by egress changes. New MFA devices require provider audit, while inbox changes require mailbox audit. Unusual logons can be investigated in Windows or VPN records. Banyan covers some VPN and Windows evidence only.
C08-M09-L05-F1.note: Evidence gaps describe the limits of the available collection.
